user.title: Configure Smart Load Manager OJM
user.description: Before continuing: enable the Voltage sensor for each Easee charger under Settings → Devices & services → Easee → the charger → Entities. Include disabled entities if needed. Wait until the sensor shows a measured value. Select the Easee charger and meter sources. EnergyTariff must be installed and configured first. After setup, one Forbruksgrense setting is shared by the installation and used as the calculation target. {validation_error}

data_description.charger_device: Select the Easee device to control. Status, current, voltage, phase data, and current limits are discovered from its entities.
data_description.han_power_entity: Select instantaneous power from the HAN meter used by EnergyTariff. The unit must be W or kW; energy counters in kWh cannot be used.
data_description.tariff_used_entity: Select the EnergyTariff sensor for energy used during the current hour. This value is required for the calculation.
data_description.safety_margin_kwh: Subtracted from the available energy to allow for meter delay and changing household load.

add_charger.title: Add charger
add_charger.description: Before continuing: enable the Voltage sensor for each Easee charger under Settings → Devices & services → Easee → the charger → Entities. Include disabled entities if needed. Wait until the sensor shows a measured value. Choose another Easee charger. The household limit and meter sources are shared. {validation_error}

household.description: These sources and the safety margin apply to the whole SLM installation and are shared by both chargers. Existing charging settings are retained. {validation_error}
